title: AuthProvider::auth_header() should return &str, not String
description: auth_header() returns Option<(&'static str, String)> — the String clone happens on every request. BearerAuth and BasicAuth pre-compute the value at construction, so returning &str borrowed from &self avoids the per-request allocation. Signature change: fn auth_header(&self) -> Option<(&'static str, &str)>. Pre-1.0 is the window to fix this; after 1.0 it requires a major version bump and will force every AuthProvider implementor to change. Impact: every HTTP and WS call site clones an unnecessary String today.
